title: Driver Assistance and Roadside Assistance
summary: This topic combines praise for helpful driver-assistance features, complaints about poor guidance and assistance-button communication, and many mentions of roadside assistance or assistance availability without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise driver-assistance features as helpful and enjoyable to use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on inadequate documentation for enhanced driving assistance and unclear guidance about using the assistance button.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention roadside assistance availability, dealer help, or assistance-feature references without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a more specific sentiment summary.
This cluster mixes at least two related but distinct subjects: driver-assistance features and roadside or dealer assistance.
Some undetermined fragments contain potentially evaluative wording, but the assigned sentiment does not provide enough basis to reclassify them.
